# Announcements

Stay up to date with product launches, company news, and important milestones.

- JUL 2026
[ProductJul 21, 2026New **Bringing high-value B2B commerce to the agentic web** Online shopping has been around for 30 years. In that time we learned to buy almost everything from a screen: books, clothes, electronics, groceries, cars. But if you need a heat shrink machine or a hydraulic truck crane, the process still looks the way it did in 1995. Weeks of phone calls. Long email chains. A negotiation that only ends when two humans agree.](https://www.gushwork.ai/announcement/agentic-commerce)
- JUN 2026
[ProductJun 2, 2026 **Meet AI Editor: Make Quick Page Updates in Plain English** AI Editor gives Gushwork customers a faster way to update page details, refresh copy, and keep their pages accurate, all by typing simple instructions.](https://www.gushwork.ai/announcement/ai-editor)
- FEB 2026
[CompanyFeb 26, 2026 **Gushwork Raises $9M to Help Businesses Win the AI Search Era** We're excited to announce that Gushwork has raised $9 million in seed funding led by Susquehanna, with participation from Lightspeed, B Capital, Seaborne Capital, Beenext, Sparrow Capital, and 2.2 Capital. This investment fuels our mission to help businesses grow in the age of AI.](https://www.gushwork.ai/announcement/seed)
